newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria seeks $100 mln credit from Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria seeks $100 mln credit from Kuwait.

text.p: Bulgarian President Petar Stoyanov left on Monday for a three-day official visit to Kuwait, saying he hoped to win a $100 million credit to support his country's economic reforms.

"I think I will be able to negotiate a $100 million credit for Bulgaria from Kuwait's Arab Economic Cooperation Fund, which will be a partial compensation for the losses we suffered during the Gulf War," President Stoyanov told reporters.
He said he hoped the visit would boost bilateral trade and economic cooperation and would promote foreign investment badly needed in Bulgaria.
Stoyanov said he was due to meet Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah and acting Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah.
Iraq has a debt of $1.6 billion to Bulgaria dating from before its 1990 invasion of Kuwait, and United Nations sanctions mean there is little prospect of quick repayment.
